summary:
All four footer-health specs pass (136 passing). The 14 failures are pre-existing and unrelated to this change: the `Tutorial details screen` suite, and the `App shell routing` integration specs whose `httpMock.verify()` trips on the unhandled `GET /api/health` request introduced by the earlier health-check correction (that file even carries a `KNOWN-DEFECT` comment claiming health isn't implemented). I left them untouched.

**Changes (all in `src/app/`, frontend only):**
- `app.component.ts` — added an `apiLoading` flag, initialised `true` and cleared in both the `next` and `error` handlers of the existing `HealthService.get()` subscription. Status values are unchanged (`ok` / `unavailable` / `unknown`), per the recorded rule.
- `app.component.html` — the `.app-footer-health` span now renders a spinner element while `apiLoading`, carries `aria-busy`, and binds `is-loading` / `is-ok` / `is-error`.
- `app.component.css` — `is-ok` green, `is-error` red, plus a small `currentColor` border spinner with a reduced-motion fallback.
- `app.component.spec.ts` — three specs: spinner + `is-loading` present during the request, spinner gone and `is-ok` after success, spinner gone and `is-error` after a 500.

Reading taken: the green/red styling the request calls "existing" was not present on this branch (it came from a sibling correction), so I implemented it here alongside the loading indicator, with "not ok" meaning any status other than `ok`. Nothing in this request belongs to the backend repo — `GET /api/health` is already in place and consumed unchanged.

visual_check.evidence: On /tutorials (1440x900) the footer renders the health status as red bold 'API: unavailable' with no spinner, i.e. the completed-state colouring is preserved; the markup/CSS add an `is-loading` state with an animated `.app-footer-health-spinner` next to 'API: …' that is shown only while `apiLoading` is true (the transient loading frame could not be captured live because network interception was not permitted, but the app.component specs assert the spinner + is-loading class before the response and its removal with is-ok/is-error after success/failure).

endpoints.purpose: API health check rendered as "API: {{ status }}" in the app footer

context_sharing.notes: HealthService calls the relative path '/health' and ApiInterceptor prefixes it with environment.apiUrl ('http://localhost:5001/api'), so the effective URL is http://localhost:5001/api/health — not '/api/health' at the app origin. `status` is optional on the Health model; the component falls back to 'unknown' if it is missing/empty and shows 'unavailable' on any HTTP error, so the footer only reads 'API: ok' when the body is exactly {"status":"ok"}.
